Component.name: AFC/Platform
Component.Note: Freestanding x86-64 entry, raw syscall boundary, signals, fixed storage.

Component.name: AFC/Compatibility
Component.Note: Acer, DAM WMI, module, DMI range, and character-device validation implemented; model database currently contains ANV15-51.

Component.name: AFC/Sensors
Component.Note: Bounded dynamic discovery for trusted CPU and GPU hwmon providers.

Component.name: AFC/Control
Component.Note: Scaled stepped curve, immediate rise, delayed gradual fall, sensor fail-safe, and controlled restore.

Component.name: AFC/DriverSetup
Component.Note: Separate DKMS, module-load, capability sysfs, udev, and permissions integration.

Component.name: AFC/Packaging
Component.Note: Destination compilation, atomic installation, hardened systemd activation, explicit range configuration, conflict preservation, and rollback are implemented.

Component.name: AFC/Documentation
Component.Note: GitHub README and MIT license document safety, compatibility, installation, operation, architecture, troubleshooting, and contribution requirements.

Component.name: AFC/Verification
Component.Note: Static release compilation, ELF/startup inspection, host discovery, and curve checks pass; live fan writes and fault injection remain pending.
